review_text: The camera quality on the Apex Smartphone Pro is absolutely mind-blowing! Low light photos look crisp and vibrant. The display is bright even under direct sunlight, and the battery life easily lasts two full days with heavy usage.
Extremely disappointed with the battery performance. The battery drains quickly from 100% to 20% in less than 4 hours. It also overheats noticeably while charging. The customer support was unhelpful.
Great overall performance and snappy software. The 120Hz display is super smooth. However, the price is slightly steep for what it offers, and the speaker sound quality is just average.

The build quality feels plasticky and fragile. The headband snapped after just two weeks of normal desk use. Sound was okay before it broke.
